page.overview:
What is Pharm?

The Kingdom of Pharm or sometimes simply Pharm is nation in Final Fantasy Brave Exvius and one of the last ones to be found in season one. Although not featured in depth during its main story, the country's history is mentioned throughout Story Events and would later have its origins explained in War of the Visions: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius.

The Kingdom of Pharm was founded by a woman of the same name, a ninja warrior and sole survivor of a small nation from Ardra which was massacred by a cowardly assault by the second division of the Kingdom of Lykeros. Pharm with the help of Fennes commanders Oldoa and Kilphe drove the forces out. Now adopting the name of "Pharm", the ninja departed vowing to build a nation free of war. The ninja named Pharm thus migrated into another continent and successfully built the nation named after her and her people.

The kingdom of Pharm is stylized in-game after the former country's customs which themselves are inspired on the country of Japan, especially from that of the Edo period, featuring Ninja, Samurai and Martial Artists as their more prominent militia. Their buildings and decorations are also typical of traditional Japan design.

Much like Japan, Pharm was, contrary to the wishes of its founder, known to have a gloomy warring period plagued by constant civil war and social unrest amongst different feudal lords and their subjects, fighting for control over the land or otherwise protect their own, all of which are hinted to have occurred centuries ago, although the exact date is not disclosed.
